findings.evidence: Recognition.lean:339,353,377,396 are character-identical; `demushkinRank_def` is the only bridge (Basic.lean:118) and is re-applied each time.

findings.issue: `have : Infinite G := hD.infinite_of_two_le_demushkinRank (by rw [demushkinRank_def]; exact hn)` is repeated verbatim at lines 339, 353, 377, 396; the reusable fact (a Demushkin group with `1 < topologicalGeneratorRankNat G hfg` is infinite) is hidden inline. `Finite.lean` only offers the `demushkinRank`-phrased `infinite_of_two_le_demushkinRank` (line 118); no `topologicalGeneratorRankNat`-phrased variant exists (grep for `1 < topologicalGeneratorRankNat` matches only Recognition.lean:323).

findings.evidence: Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Subgroup/Lattice.lean:126 `def topEquiv : (⊤ : Subgroup G) ≃* G := Submonoid.topEquiv`; grep finds no `Subgroup.topEquiv_symm_apply*` lemma and no `topContinuousMulEquiv` in either repo.
findings.fix: Give the fields explicitly (`toFun := fun x ↦ ⟨x, Subgroup.mem_top x⟩`, `invFun := Subtype.val`, `map_mul' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl`) so continuity matches syntactically, or add a comment stating the unfolding, as done at `RepresentationTheory/Homological/TateCohomology/IsoCriterion.lean:165`.
findings.issue: `{ Subgroup.topEquiv.symm with continuous_toFun := continuous_id.subtype_mk … }` typechecks only because `⇑Subgroup.topEquiv.symm` unfolds, through `MulEquiv.symm` and `Submonoid.topEquiv`, to `fun x ↦ ⟨x, _⟩`; the comment documents the mathematics (case `U = ⊤`) but not this defeq, and Mathlib has no continuous version of `Subgroup.topEquiv` (only `Submodule.topContEquiv`) to lean on.

summary: The four new equivalences re-derive the same two proof steps instead of factoring them: the `Infinite G` bridge from `1 < topologicalGeneratorRankNat` appears verbatim four times, and the forward implication is written twice per criterion. The `⊤`-equivalence is built by inheriting from `Subgroup.topEquiv.symm` and relies on its unfolding for the continuity fields, undocumented.
